description: Read the playback queue. Use this for queue CONTENTS (what is playing, what is up next, how long it runs, what repeats). Use peek_next for a short lookahead. Quota: 1 read; view=enriched and include=runtime add one GET /me/player, and the context label adds one catalog read.

include.description: Local analyses over the same single read, no extra request except runtime: runtime = total/avg/longest/shortest, time left on the current track, and a per-item timeline of when each row starts playing; duplicates = repeated rows and the runtime they waste; profile = unique artists/albums/shows, track-vs-episode mix, longest single-artist run.

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

view.description: 'raw' (default) = the queue as returned. 'enriched' = plus the source context (playlist/album name) and total time remaining.

name: get_queue
